*Lokiyaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.30) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It examines the analytical intersection of the mundane dyad (*lokiya-duka*) and the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) within the matrix of conditional relations [SuttaCentral]. The text has no registered English title or translation in the SuttaCentral database, and it is not discussed in the provided secondary literature dossier [SuttaCentral].
